description_en: Resets the password of an account
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx reset-account-password-restrict --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000 --account-name testaccount --account-password 00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAccountPasswordRestrict

parameters.help_en: The region ID. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域id。>您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the account whose password you want to reset. > Only the passwords of standard accounts can be reset
parameters.help_zh: 需要重置密码的账号名称。>仅支持重置普通账号的密码
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The account information for the accounts whose passwords you want to reset. Separate multiple account entries with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要重置密码的账号信息，多个账号信息间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en: The name of the account whose password you want to reset. > Only the passwords of standard accounts can be reset. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196844.html operation to query the account information of the target instance, including account names
parameters.help_zh: 需要重置密码的账号名称。>仅支持重置普通账号的密码。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196844.html接口查看目标实例的账号信息，包括账号名称
parameters.name: security_account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the security administrator account. > This parameter is required if the three-role mode is enabled. For more information about the three-role mode, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213824.html
parameters.help_zh: 安全管理员账号的密码。>若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填。更多关于三权分置模式的信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213824.html
parameters.name: security_account_password
